description: Answer evals for /ask. Checks are formal (no LLM judge yet; that comes in milestone 6): expected_status must match; every doc in must_cite must be among the cited sources; for ambiguous, a clarifying question must be present; answer_contains lists substrings the answer must contain (case-insensitive); a Ukrainian question must get an answer in Ukrainian (Cyrillic). Off-topic ids o01/o09/o10 reuse questions from evals/off_topic.json.

items.question: What is average order value and how is it calculated?

items.note: CAC cannot be calculated from Olist, but a definition question is still answered.
